[[File:Jedi_archives.jpg|thumb|right|The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]] held millions of holobooks.]]

A '''holobook''' was a slim, crystalline board which was used to store vast amounts of information. Holobooks were incredibly durable and required only a small amount of power to remain active. The [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], contained millions of holobooks, some of which dated back to the origins of the Republic. When properly stored and maintained, holobooks gave off a soft, light blue glow. Like the [[Holocron/Legends|Jedi Holocrons]], holobooks provided interactive interfaces to their knowledge, allowing a reader to delve as deeply into subject matter as they desired.
